build.script:
set -eu
mkdir -p /home/root/fntech3-builds
src=$(mktemp -d /home/root/fntech3-builds/clean-218ab89-XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' "$src" > /mnt/e/Repositories/fnTech3/.tmp/linux-218ab89-source-path.txt
tar -xf /mnt/e/Repositories/fnTech3/.tmp/linux-218ab89-source.tar -C "$src"
mkdir -p "$src/subprojects/packagecache"
cp /mnt/e/Repositories/fnTech3/subprojects/packagecache/*.xz /mnt/e/Repositories/fnTech3/subprojects/packagecache/*.gz /mnt/e/Repositories/fnTech3/subprojects/packagecache/*.zip "$src/subprojects/packagecache/"
cd "$src"
meson setup .tmp/build --cross-file misc/meson/linux-x86.ini --buildtype=release -Dbuild-client=true -Dbuild-server=true -Dsdl=disabled -Dcurl=enabled -Dcurl-dlopen=true -Dogg-vorbis=true -Drenderer-dlopen=true -Drenderers=glx,vk,rtx -Daudio-tests=true -Dglx-tests=true
meson compile -C .tmp/build -j 8

meson test -C .tmp/build --no-rebuild --print-errorlogs

server.config:
set sv_pure 1
set sv_autoRecordDemos 0
set sv_maxclients 2
set cl_allowDownload 0
set cl_motd 0
set com_maxfps 60
set com_maxfpsUnfocused 60
set com_maxfpsMinimized 60
set cl_shownet 2
set sv_master1 ""
set sv_master2 ""
set sv_master3 ""
set sv_master4 ""
set sv_master5 ""
map q3dm6
wait 1000
quit

client.config:
set sv_pure 1
set sv_autoRecordDemos 0
set sv_maxclients 2
set cl_allowDownload 0
set cl_motd 0
set com_maxfps 60
set com_maxfpsUnfocused 60
set com_maxfpsMinimized 60
set cl_shownet 2
set sv_master1 ""
set sv_master2 ""
set sv_master3 ""
set sv_master4 ""
set sv_master5 ""
set activeAction "wait 120; screenshotPNG linux-proof; wait 3; quit"
connect 127.0.0.1:52398

qlDedicated.config:
set sv_pure 1
set sv_autoRecordDemos 0
map campgrounds ffa
wait 80
status
quit
